```yaml
name: Publish connectors prerelease command

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull request number to comment on'
        required: true
        type: string
      comment_tag:
        description: 'Unique tag for the comment (used to replace the comment later)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set short SHA
        run: echo "SHORT_SHA=${GITHUB_SHA:0:10}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post start comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :rocket: Publishing pre-release connector builds for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.
            Expected image tags: `{version}-dev.${{ env.SHORT_SHA }}`
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          comment-tag: ${{ inputs.comment_tag }}
          mode: replace
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Call publish_connectors.yml
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          modified: true

      - name: Post success comment
        if: success()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :white_check_mark: Pre-release connector builds published successfully for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          comment-tag: ${{ inputs.comment_tag }}
          mode: replace
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post failure comment
        if: failure()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            :x: Failed to publish pre-release connector builds for PR #${{ inputs.pr_number }}.
          pr-number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          comment-tag: ${{ inputs.comment_tag }}
          mode: replace
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
